build.walk_rule: 8-direction straight-line raster walk, corner cutting forbidden, x wraps mod 2160; per-segment passability is a hard build error
build.spoke_rule: one spoke per port: nearest snapped lane waypoint within Chebyshev 20 of the harbor tile (wrap-aware; ties smallest (y, x), then lane file order, then waypoint index), else the passable direct walk to the national capital, else the tools/route_overrides.json spoke (A*-pathfound); a port with none is a hard error
build.junction_rule: node = tile shared by >= 2 distinct paths or a path endpoint, keyed (x mod 2160, y); each path splits at its nodes into edges weighted by tile steps
